story.title: Story 2: Event Capture and Turn Derivation

artifactsRead: manual node reproduction: resume/reload idempotency collision using built packages/pi-lhc/dist/index.js
result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification covered Story 2 AC/TC requirements, Flow 2 tech design, capture/runtime production paths, Story 2 tests, configured gates, and manual existing-thread reattach scenarios.

newFindings.title: Existing-thread resume/reload can silently skip new finalized events
newFindings.evidence: AC-2.1 requires every finalized PI message to be recorded exactly once, and AC-2.6/TC-2.7 require duplicate safety without normal-resume historical replay. On every session_start, createConnector resets captureSession.sourceSeq to 0 in packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:310-318; nextEntryId then returns s0, s1, ... in packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:352-357; message/runtime hooks use that generated entryId in packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:362-384. eventKey gives entryId first precedence in packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/idempotency.ts:35-40, so a fresh connector attached to an existing thread reuses prior keys. Manual reproduction against the built production connector: after recording user_prompt 'first', starting a fresh connector with --session for the same thread and recording user_prompt 'second after resume', intakeStream.listEvents returned only the first event with key pi:th_947f6dd71f50d513:entry:s0:0:user_prompt and connector diag was null. The same reload shape returned only the first event with key pi:th_d1fc3d71df1144d3:entry:s0:0:user_prompt. Existing TC-2.7 coverage in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/parallel-and-errors.test.ts:108-153 only proves identical batch re-delivery skips; it does not prove normal resume/reload continues recording new events.

gatesRun.command: manual node --input-type=module existing-thread resume/reload idempotency reproduction

productionPathFindings: Production capture path uses real LHC intakeStream.messageEvents, but reattach state is not durable: sourceSeq and turn_end closedCount reset for every fresh connector, making new events on existing threads collide with prior idempotency keys.
No material fake/mock intake path was found in Story 2 capture modules; test fakes are confined to fixtures and explicit test SDK config.
additionalObservations: Configured gates passed with 54 tests, but the current suite does not cover the existing-thread resume/reload collision path.
